params.name: rows
params.description: The number of rows per page

params.name: order
params.description: Combined with sort can be used to specify the order of results, e.g. asc or desc

params.name: facet
params.description: Exposes the ability to retrieve counts for pre-defined facets e.g. `type-name:*` returns counts of all works by type

params.name: sample
params.description: Exposes the ability to return `N` randomly sampled items

params.name: sort
params.description: Exposes the ability to sort results by a certain field, e.g. `score`

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of rows to skip before returning

params.name: mailto
params.description: The email address to identify yourself and be in the "polite pool"

params.name: select
params.description: Exposes the ability to select certain fields, supports a comma separated list of fields, e.g. `DOI,volume`

params.name: query
params.description: Exposes the ability to free text query certain fields

params.name: filter
params.description: Exposes the ability to filter by certain fields, supports a comma separated list of lucene filters, e.g. `content-domain:psychoceramics.labs.crossref.org`

params.name: cursor
params.description: Exposes the ability to deep page through large result sets, where offset would cause performance problems

items.docs:
Returns list of works associated with specified {prefix}.
## Queries

Free form search queries can be made, for example, works that include `renear` or `ontologies` (or both):

##

```
/works?query=renear+ontologies
```


## Field Queries
Field queries allow for queries that match only particular fields of metadata. For example, this query matches records that contain the tokens `richard` or `feynman` (or both) in any author field:

##

```
/works?query.author=richard+feynman
```
